title: Mushroom {p} Burgers
steps: Press the {p} between towels under a weight for 15 minutes, then crumble it. Chop the {v} fine and sauté 6 to 8 minutes, until the moisture cooks off.
Mash the {p}, the cooked {v}, the {spice}, a spoonful of soy sauce, half a cup of oats or breadcrumbs, and a spoonful of ground flaxseed stirred with 3 tablespoons of water, until it holds together.
Shape into 4 firm patties and pan-fry in a little oil over medium heat 5 to 6 minutes a side, until deeply golden and firm.
Toast the {s}, spread with the {sauce}, and build the burgers with lettuce and sliced tomato.
tip: Serve on one bun half with a big side salad.
